components.name: TemplateRepository (Aggregate Root)
components.description: Filesystem-backed repository for plan templates stored as TOML files in `.rigorix/templates/`.

components.name: ListTemplatesHandler (Domain Service)
components.description: Handles `rigorix_list_templates` tool calls: discovers templates from filesystem.

components.name: GetTemplateHandler (Domain Service)
components.description: Handles `rigorix_get_template` tool calls: reads and returns a specific template.

components.name: CreateTemplateHandler (Domain Service)
components.description: Handles `rigorix_create_template` tool calls: validates and saves a new template.

components.name: ValidateTemplateHandler (Domain Service)
components.description: Handles `rigorix_validate_template` tool calls: validates template structure.

components.name: TemplateConverter (Domain Service)
components.description: Converts between TOML (filesystem storage) and JSON (MCP transport) template formats.
